blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a restrained monochromatic blue palette and a genuinely striking HCL color scatter panel; axis labels at 9px push the readability floor but overall design intent is clear and consistent.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest throughout — scaleSqrt used for both network nodes and color bubbles, histogram Y-axis starts at zero with data-driven domain, HCL fixed axes [0,360]/[0,100] are semantically correct, no dual-axis abuse — minor: fgBars data join lacks a key function but monthly bins are positionally stable so no visible corruption.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces all brush/click updates; no transitions so no mid-flight snap risk; pointer events avoid mouse-touch fight; brush handlers close over static scales with no resize listener (stale on window resize), and renderList rebuilds up to 200 DOM nodes via innerHTML on every filter change though coalesced through RAF.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views stay within working memory limits, the monochromatic network (60 pre-settled nodes) avoids color overload, and the color scatter is self-encoding, but the dense color point cloud in the right panel is harder to parse than the rest of the layout warrants.
